cohort: N/A - this abstract is a review discussing complications in general patient populations undergoing cesarean sections.
finding: Uterine wound dehiscence, pelvic hematoma, and abscess collection are rare but serious complications following cesarean sections, requiring a high index of suspicion for early diagnosis and appropriate management.
mod_finding: Cesarean section, as a mode of birth, is associated with rare but serious complications such as uterine wound dehiscence and pelvic abscess.
